blockingIssues.description: Multiple /api/profiles endpoints no longer preserve the legacy route-local 500 `{ error: message }` failure behavior and now fall through to the global error envelope instead.
`POST /api/workflows/run` and `POST /api/workflows/stop` moved critical state checks outside `automationMutex`, reintroducing duplicate-start and stop races that the pre-refactor handler avoided.
`POST /api/automation/start` and `POST /api/automation/stop` now validate process state before taking `automationMutex`, allowing duplicate starts and potential 500s on concurrent stops.

Workflow endpoints changed their public error contract from legacy `{ error: string }` responses with 400/429/502 codes to the shared `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }` envelope with 409/503 semantics.

`server/shared/ProcessService.ts` lost the direct `SIGKILL` fallback for non-detached Unix child processes in both `killProcess()` and `killByPid()`, so stubborn profile/manual processes may no longer be force-stopped.
The shared Convex HTTP error categorizer still maps many existing plain validation errors like `name is required` to HTTP 500 instead of 400-class responses.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md with the canonical `server/shared/*` module paths plus the invariant that automation/workflow admission checks must remain inside `automationMutex` critical sections.

Updated .factory/library/architecture.md with Convex module-split API path notes, the distinction between the two Convex inventory tests, and the need to preserve 4xx mapping for plain-string validation errors in HTTP wrappers.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When preserving public APIs during refactors, explicitly require preservation of HTTP status codes and response-body shape, not just route paths and function signatures.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `server-ddd-profiles` and `server-ddd-workflows` both preserved route mounts but still regressed API failure semantics after adopting shared error handling.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Define when scoped validation is allowed versus when the full five-command suite is mandatory, and add a dedicated verify-only procedure/skill for validation features that do not change runtime code.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `server-ddd-automation` and `server-convex-verify` both marked `followedProcedure=true` despite not following the documented full validation sequence; the mismatch appeared in multiple reviews.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Do not allow `followedProcedure=true` when mandatory startup reads or required verification steps were skipped; make the check explicit in the worker handoff contract.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `server-ddd-profiles` skipped the documented architecture.md read, and multiple reviewed features skipped required validation steps while still reporting full procedure compliance.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add Windows-safe command guidance: prefer PowerShell line counts and fixed-string Grep searches for literal import paths instead of POSIX `wc -l` or regex-heavy patterns by default.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `convex-http-split` and `server-ddd-remaining-domains` both hit avoidable Windows command/search failures before switching to PowerShell or fixed-string searches.
